title: OpenAI has reportedly cut a $30 billion target, and closed $11 billion
friendlyTitle: OpenAI has reportedly lowered a funding target, and raised $11 billion so far
summary: On 31 October TechCrunch reported, citing the Financial Times, that OpenAI has lowered a funding target from $30 billion to $20 billion, with a first close expected to be lower still. A Wall Street Journal follow-up, also cited by TechCrunch, said the company had secured $11 billion so far and met a tepid response from some large investors. The round is reported to be led by investors from the United Arab Emirates. TechCrunch said it had asked OpenAI for comment.

whyItMatters: OpenAI has not confirmed the figures in the report TechCrunch published. The practical reading is about timing, not a product change. TechCrunch ties the softer raise to investors pulling back from heavy AI infrastructure spending, and notes that Anthropic's planned listing is also facing reported credit questions.
